title: Jack’s Bar
desc: Posters that look less like advertising and more like Friday night

blocks.title: Jack’s Bar
blocks.lede: A poster series that looks less like advertising and more like Friday night.

items.statement: The brief was simple: make it feel like the place.
body: Jack’s Bar didn’t need another poster with a cocktail sitting politely on a background. The visuals needed the same energy as the room — playful, loud and slightly chaotic.

items.statement: Turn every poster into its own tiny world.
body: Cocktails become alpine peaks. Hourglasses drip with booze. Typography elbows its way into the scene. The imagery is exaggerated on purpose.

blocks.text: Make the poster feel like the place before you’ve even walked in.

body: A series built from bold shapes, strong colour relationships and surreal Alpine transformations. Rather than putting an offer on a background, each poster becomes a small visual event.
The posters became part of the atmosphere rather than just another communication layer — something guests could notice, photograph and remember.
